metadata.name: Skip Pickup Animations
metadata.description:
This is a companion mod to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3681716665]Skip Giantbook Animations[/url].
It lets you press the drop button to skip the pickup or use item animations (hands up). These animations play when the player picks up a collectible/trinket/card/pill/etc. You're generally vulnerable when this happens (can't shoot). This lets you get back into combat as soon as possible.
Items like Bob's Rotten Head or Red Candle are not affected.
REPENTOGON is required.
Update: You can skip the happy or sad animations (which also block you from shooting). These can happen after using a pill.
